image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a vintage comic book cover titled 'MAD DOG'. The cover features psychedelic, hand-drawn artwork with bold colors (yellow, green, red) and distorted character illustrations. Text elements include the title in a jagged font at the top and smaller promotional text on the left ('12 PAGES OF COLOR', 'THE GORGA'). The paper appears aged with some wear on the edges. A portion of another comic or object is visible at the very bottom edge.
